questions: When the board is fully visible, does it hold exactly three pens arranged in a single row?
Are all three pens aligned identically, all pointing the same way, including any pen near the left or right frame edge as it enters or exits?
Do all three pens share identical barrel and cap colors, with no mismatch?
Is every pen fully capped with no exposed writing tip, and are all three pens equal in length?
Does the board advance steadily from left to right at EVERY moment, never halting, freezing, or pausing even briefly (1-3 seconds) at any point in the video?
Do all pens stay fixed in their positions on the board, with no pen shifting, sliding, or moving on its own relative to the board mid-clip?

question_answers.evidence: When the board is fully visible (around 00:10), there are exactly three pens arranged in a row.
All three pens are oriented vertically with the writing end (or capped end) pointing downwards and the back/clicker end pointing upwards.
All three pens appear to be black or dark grey in color.
The leftmost pen shows a bare, pointed writing tip at the bottom, while the middle and right pens have black caps covering their tips.
The board moves smoothly from left to right throughout the clip without stopping or reversing.
The pens remain fixed in their positions on the board relative to each other.

parsed.reason: The leftmost pen is uncapped, showing a bare writing tip, while the other two pens are capped. This violates the nominal condition that all pens must be complete and capped.

description: One pen is missing its cap while the others are capped.
